text: RB IAM-101 [SSO / SAML]: SAML 2.0 assertion validation failed due to NTP clock skew > 180s. Synchronize chronyd NTP daemon on application nodes and verify IdP metadata timestamp.
RB IAM-102 [OAuth2 / Token]: OAuth2 refresh token rotation loop invalidating active mobile sessions. Enable 30-second refresh token grace window in Okta authorization server.

RB IAM-103 [LDAP / AD]: Active Directory account lockout storm caused by cached stale service credentials on legacy batch host. Identify source IP via Event ID 4740 and update Windows Credential Manager.
RB IAM-104 [CloudIAM / RBAC]: GCP/AWS cross-account IAM AssumeRole AccessDenied due to missing externalId condition or expired STS session. Update trust policy and refresh short-lived credentials.
RB IAM-105 [VPN / ZeroTrust]: Corporate WireGuard / ZTNA split-tunnel DNS resolution failure for *.internal domains. Push updated CoreDNS upstream forwarder profile to VPN clients.

RB IAM-106 [Security / SocialEng]: Helpdesk ticket contains credential leak or prompt injection requesting unauthorized admin elevation. Reject request immediately, revoke leaked token, and alert SOC.
RB IAM-107 [SCIM / Provisioning]: Okta-to-GitHub SCIM user provisioning failing with HTTP 409 conflict on existing external handle. Link existing enterprise SAML identity and retry SCIM sync.
RB IAM-108 [MFA / WebAuthn]: FIDO2 / WebAuthn hardware key authentication rejected after custom domain migration. Update rpId origin allowlist in authentication policy.
RB IAM-109 [K8s / OIDC]: kubectl OIDC login failing with x509 certificate signed by unknown authority. Update kube-apiserver --oidc-ca-file bundle and refresh kubeconfig.
RB IAM-110 [PAM / JIT]: Privileged Access Management Just-In-Time elevation expired mid-maintenance window. Require manager approval ticket and issue bounded 2-hour break-glass role.
